title: Tommy's breakfast 汤米的早餐
description: A story about Tommy's breakfast: his father drops some coins on the dining room floor while going in, the family looks everywhere but cannot find them, and Tommy, having found two small coins, puts both into his mouth and swallows them. The lesson covers the past continuous with 'while' and 'when', 'later', 'any change' and the words swallow, later, toilet, dining room, coin and mouth.
answer_note: Listening and picture questions are model answers (suggested). Workbook A (Complete the text) and B (Vocabulary) are from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-112-117.jpg). Grammar I-III are from the grammar workbook answer key (source-key, pdf p.552-553).

lesson.text: Listen then answer this question. 听录音，然后回答问题。

What does she mean by 'change' in the last sentence?

When my husband was going into the dining room this morning, he dropped some coins on the floor.
There were coins everywhere.
We looked for them,
but we could not find them all.

While we were having breakfast, our little boy, Tommy, found two small coins on the floor.
He put them both into his mouth.
We both tried to get the coins, but it was too late.
Tommy had already swallowed them!

Later that morning, when I was doing the housework, my husband phoned me from the office.
'How's Tommy?' he asked.
'I don't know,' I answered.
'Tommy's been to the toilet three times this morning, but I haven't had any change yet!' (Suggested answer / 参考答案)
lesson.translation:
最后一句话中的“change”是什么意思？（零钱）

今天早上我丈夫走进饭厅时，把一些硬币掉在了地上。
到处都是硬币。
我们虽然找了，但没能把它们全部找到。

正当我们吃早饭时，我们的小儿子汤米在地上找到了两枚小硬币。
他把这两枚硬币全都放进了嘴里。我们俩都试图把硬币弄出来，但太迟了。汤米已经把硬币咽了下去！

那天上午的晚些时候，当我正做家务时，我丈夫从办公室打来电话。
“汤米怎么样？”他问。
“我不知道。”我回答说。
“今天上午汤米去了3次厕所了，但我还没看到硬币！”

lesson.title: What does she mean by 'change' in the last sentence?
lesson.instruction: Answer the question. 回答这个问题。
lesson.context: Comprehension question about the final line.

questions.prompt: What does she mean by 'change' in the last sentence?
questions.answer: She means small coins. 'Change' here refers to the coins Tommy swallowed.

grammar.title: Grammar I: Combine each pair of sentences, using 'while' according to the examples
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句用 while 连接下列各句。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用 while 连接下列各句。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.552 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 10 combine-with-while items; items 1 and 6 are printed examples.

questions.prompt: I was speaking to Mrs. Li yesterday. Her son started to cry.
questions.answer: While I was speaking to Mrs. Li yesterday, her son started to cry.

questions.prompt: He was crossing the street two days ago. He slipped and fell down.
questions.answer: While he was crossing the street two days ago, he slipped and fell down.

questions.prompt: I was having a bath last night. The telephone rang.
questions.answer: While I was having a bath last night, the telephone rang.

questions.prompt: She was having dinner yesterday evening. Someone knocked at the door.
questions.answer: While she was having dinner yesterday evening, someone knocked at the door.

questions.prompt: She was cutting the meat this morning. She cut her finger.
questions.answer: While she was cutting the meat this morning, she cut her finger.

questions.prompt: The child hurt himself. He was climbing a tree.
questions.answer: The child hurt himself while he was climbing a tree.

questions.prompt: Someone came to see me. We were watching television last night.
questions.answer: Someone came to see me while we were watching television last night.

questions.prompt: Tom fell asleep. He was sitting in his armchair.
questions.answer: Tom fell asleep while he was sitting in his armchair.

questions.prompt: The policeman saw an accident. He was walking down the street.
questions.answer: The policeman saw an accident while he was walking down the street.

questions.prompt: Someone turned on the stereo. We were reading in the library.
questions.answer: Someone turned on the stereo while we were reading in the library.

grammar.title: Grammar III: Make sentences, using 'just as' according to the example
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句用 just as 造句。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用 just as 造句。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.553 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 8 make-sentences items; item 1 is the printed example.

questions.prompt: I / take off my coat / the telephone / ring
questions.answer: Just as I was taking off my coat, the telephone rang.

questions.prompt: he / leave the office / his assistant / come in
questions.answer: Just as he was leaving the office, his assistant came in.

questions.prompt: I / walk out of the building / it / begin to rain
questions.answer: Just as I was walking out of the building, it began to rain.

questions.prompt: she / open the door / someone / come in
questions.answer: Just as she was opening the door, someone came in.

questions.prompt: I / go to sleep / I / hear a loud noise from the road
questions.answer: Just as I was going to sleep, I heard a loud noise from the road.

questions.prompt: we / go upstairs / they / come downstairs
questions.answer: Just as we were going upstairs, they came downstairs.

questions.prompt: he / lean out of the window / something / drop on his head
questions.answer: Just as he was leaning out of the window, something dropped on his head.

questions.prompt: he / light a cigarette / someone / come and tell him not to smoke
questions.answer: Just as he was lighting a cigarette, someone came and told him not to smoke.

characters.wife: The wife/mother, a woman with curly hair and a polka-dot dress.

l117-scene.description: Six numbered panels: 1 the husband dropping coins on the dining room floor; 2 coins scattered all over the floor; 3 Tommy finding two small coins on the floor while the family has breakfast; 4 the husband and wife trying to get the coins out of Tommy's mouth; 5 Tommy having swallowed them; 6 the husband phoning from the office asking about Tommy.
